root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on falling short or being remiss, with related branches of effort, ability, withholding, and oath-taking.
root_idea.development: No Maqāyīs or Mufradāt root-level discussion was supplied, so a stronger historical root principle is not assigned.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested nominal is retained as a public form, although the supplied lexical sources do not provide a direct explanation for its Quranic sense.

senses.definition: To fall short or be remiss in doing what is required; to fail to spare effort in an action.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb is used with a negative particle and an object of harmful action: they do not fall short in corrupting you.

senses.definition: To swear an oath, especially to bind oneself by oath not to perform an act.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction concerns swearing off sexual relations with one's wives; the verb may also be construed with على or with من when abstention is implied.

senses.definition: To fall short or be remiss in carrying out an action.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a reported alternative interpretation of the Quranic occurrence in 24:22; the supplied evidence gives the oath-taking interpretation as preferable.

senses.definition: To swear or bind oneself by an oath not to do something.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the oath concerns refraining from charitable support for relatives and others; this is the preferred interpretation in the supplied evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave off, cease from, omit, or neglect something or an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a thing or with a following verbal clause.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be slow, tardy, languid, or weak in carrying out an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A related state expressed by the Form I verb and its derived usages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive, labor, or exert one's power or ability to accomplish a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing effort made to fulfill a need or task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be able to perform or accomplish something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be used transitively for being able to do a specified thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold, refuse, stint, or deprive someone of something, including advice or assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a constructional use in which the verb conveys refusal or failure to provide something to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a thing or provide it to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use recorded as the contrary of refusing or withholding something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to take, make, or prepare a miʾlāh, a cloth used in wailing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use associated with the feminine form recorded in this entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possessors of, those endowed with, or persons having a specified quality or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: أُولُو is a prefixed plural form with no independent singular of its own; its corresponding feminine form is أُولَاتُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To, toward, or as far as the endpoint of a spatial or temporal extent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The endpoint may be included or excluded according to the construction and context; with a time expression it means until.

other_classical_meanings.definition: With, together with, or in addition to another person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when one thing is joined or added to another, including Quranic constructions with the sense of accompaniment or addition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particle marking the person or object in relation to whom something is more pleasing, hateful, or otherwise evaluated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs after verbs of wonder and nouns of excess in a conventional comparative or affective construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: At, or in the estimation of, someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A prepositional use synonymous with عِنْدَ in expressions of personal judgment or preference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To, for, or ultimately referred or committed to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This includes uses explained as equivalent to لِ, expressing possession, responsibility, destination of command, or final reference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Against or upon someone in a construction of decree; by extension, decisively revealed or communicated to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested construction in which the preposition is explained as equivalent to عَلَى or as conveying decisive revelation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In or into; and, in an invitational construction, toward an action one is invited to undertake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The first use is explained as equivalent to فِي; the second occurs in the construction إِلَى أَنْ followed by an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: From or beginning at a point of origin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reversal of the ordinary endpoint sense, attested in poetic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the elliptical expression إِلَيْكَ, to complain or turn oneself over to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed elliptical devotional expression with the omitted complement understood from context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Related or belonging to someone, as in the expression مِنْكَ وَإِلَيْكَ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression describing relation or affiliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In elliptical imperatives, to take or attend to something; with عَنْ, to withdraw, keep away, or refrain from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The forms إِلَيْكَ كَذَا and إِلَيْكَ عَنِّي are imperative verbal-noun constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Falling short of what is requisite; remissness, slowness, or tardiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive derived from the Form I branch of falling short or being remiss.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun has the plural أَلَايَا and belongs to the oath-taking branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who swears much or utters many oaths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person frequently given to oath-taking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Falling short, remiss, slow, or tardy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival form; its plural is also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Niggardly, penurious, or avaricious; unable or unwilling to fulfill duties, obligations, or debts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival extension describing failure to meet obligations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of cloth held by a woman while wailing and used for making gestures; also, a rag used for menstruation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a cloth or rag, with the plural مَآلٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who presumes to pronounce judgment about God's judgment, such as assigning people to Paradise or Hell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial form associated with Form V, preserved here as a specialized Classical and traditional usage.

cautions: The Quranic nominal آلَاء occurs 34 times with contextual renderings such as “favors” and “bounties,” but no direct Lane or Mufradāt lexical explanation for that sense is supplied; it is therefore displayed without a numbered sense rather than assigning a contextual gloss as lexical evidence.
For 24:22, the supplied evidence records both a falling-short interpretation and a preferred oath-taking interpretation. The secure QAC morphology identifies the occurrence as Form VIII.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Quranic form group qac-form:Alw:'aAlaA^':nominal:- is contextually glossed as “favors” or “bounties,” but the packet supplies no direct Lane or Mufradāt evidence establishing that nominal meaning.
